description: Tables without text: column widths of an auto table (shared by how wide the columns would be, a stated width kept, percentages), a cell across columns and across rows under the background of the rows, cells on the top, the middle and the bottom of their rows, a fixed layout, captions above and below a bordered table, border spacing, column groups and a header and footer written out of order, an empty cell that is not drawn, and a table inside a cell.

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 340px; height: 700px; background-color: #ffffff; } table { margin: 0 0 6px 10px; background-color: #e4e4e4; } td { background-color: #c8d8f0; } .d { height: 10px; background-color: #d05040; } .w20 { width: 20px; } .w40 { width: 40px; } .w80 { width: 80px; } .h30 { height: 30px; } .h50 { height: 50px; } .g { background-color: #40a060; } .y { background-color: #e0b030; } .v { background-color: #8050c0; } .row { background-color: #202020; } .vt { vertical-align: top; } .vb { vertical-align: bottom; } .cw50 { width: 50px; } .cw30 { width: 30px; background-color: #40a060; } .fixed { table-layout: fixed; width: 300px; } .wide { width: 300px; } .c60 { width: 60px; } .border { border: 4px solid #404040; } .spaced { border-spacing: 10px 4px; } .hide { empty-cells: hide; border: 3px solid #d05040; } .pct { width: 25%; } .cg { background-color: #e0b030; } .cap { background-color: #40a060; height: 16px; } .cb { caption-side: bottom; }
